reception: The citing literature treats the article mainly as a point of reference for the StreamIt model: streaming systems describe it and set their own designs against it, with StreamPI among those that compare directly, and it appears as a member of the standard list of streaming languages. A smaller number of works reuse its kernels in their evaluations or borrow its design rationale for other domains. Its reception largely mirrors, at smaller scale, that of the conference paper it expands.
